entities.summary: Torben Lund is a Danish politician, who served in the Folketing from 1981 to 1998 and in the European Parliament from 1999 to 2004. He was associated with the Danish Social Democrats in Denmark, and the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats in the European Parliament. Torben Lund was a legal figures from Vejle (b. 1950-11-06, Vejle). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
